}}'''Maringil''' was a Lord from a major House of [[Cairhien]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Maringil}}

== Appearance ==
He was tall and very thin, with long white hair to his shoulders.

== Activities ==
He was one of the Lords to swear fealty to [[Rand al'Thor]]. His ambition is to sit on the [[Sun Throne]] with [[Meilan Mendiana]] and [[Colavaere Saighan]] being his main rivals. After Rand was kidnapped by the [[White Tower]] [[Aes Sedai]], Maringil was assassinated by Colavaere.

== Viewing ==
* He will die by poison. ''(fulfilled)''
